verdict.rationale: BugSnag provides official SDKs for web/JS frameworks, Node.js/backend, and mobile (React Native, iOS, Flutter) that automatically detect uncaught errors, plus notify() for handled exceptions, and docs confirm 50+ platform libraries with independent community corroboration of ease of automatic crash capture. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification specifically for backend/mobile automatic capture beyond docs, only one community quote about iOS auto-reporting.
